sentences.l2: 在我的房间里，有一个特别的玩具。
sentences.l1: In my room, there is a special toy.

sentences.l2: 它是一只毛绒泰迪熊。
sentences.l1: It is a plush teddy bear.

sentences.l2: 这只熊非常可爱，它的身体软软的，摸起来很舒服。
sentences.l1: This bear is very cute; its body is soft and feels very comfortable to touch.

sentences.l2: 它最特别的地方是，它穿着一件漂亮的蓝色毛衣。
sentences.l1: The most special thing about it is that it wears a beautiful blue sweater.

sentences.l2: 这件毛衣是它一直以来都穿的，颜色是那种很深的蓝色，像夏天的夜空一样。
sentences.l1: This sweater is the one it has always worn, and the colour is a very deep blue, like a summer night sky.

sentences.l2: 这只泰迪熊是我的好朋友。
sentences.l1: This teddy bear is my good friend.

sentences.l2: 每天晚上，我都会把它抱在怀里睡觉。
sentences.l1: Every night, I hold it in my arms and sleep.

sentences.l2: 它的眼睛是黑色的，鼻子是棕色的，总是笑眯眯的样子，好像很高兴见到我。
sentences.l1: Its eyes are black, its nose is brown, and it always looks smiling, as if it is very happy to see me.

sentences.l2: 它的耳朵圆圆的，毛茸茸的，摸上去很柔软。
sentences.l1: Its ears are round and fluffy, and they feel very soft to the touch.

sentences.l2: 它的爪子也很可爱，虽然是毛绒做的，但看起来很结实，可以让我握住。
sentences.l1: Its paws are also very cute; although they are made of plush, they look very sturdy, and I can hold them.

sentences.l2: 我记得刚得到这只熊的时候，我非常开心。
sentences.l1: I remember that when I first got this bear, I was very happy.

sentences.l2: 它当时还没有穿毛衣，我妈妈说它看起来有点冷，于是就给我买了一件蓝色的毛衣给它穿上。
sentences.l1: At that time it was not yet wearing a sweater; my mum said it looked a little cold, so she bought me a blue sweater to put on it.

sentences.l2: 从那以后，这只熊就一直穿着这件蓝色的毛衣。
sentences.l1: Since then, this bear has always worn this blue sweater.

sentences.l2: 这件毛衣的毛线很细，织得很密实，冬天穿起来一定很暖和。
sentences.l1: This sweater's yarn is very fine and it is knitted very tightly, so it must be very warm to wear in winter.

sentences.l2: 上面还有一些小小的白色图案，让这件毛衣看起来不那么单调。
sentences.l1: There are also some little white patterns on it, which make this sweater look less plain.

sentences.l2: 这只熊不仅仅是一个玩具，它还承载了很多我的回忆。
sentences.l1: This bear is not just a toy; it also holds many of my memories.

sentences.l2: 在我伤心的时候，我会抱着它，感觉它给我带来了安慰。
sentences.l1: When I am sad, I hold it and feel that it brings me comfort.

sentences.l2: 在我开心的时候，我也会和它分享我的快乐。
sentences.l1: When I am happy, I also share my happiness with it.

sentences.l2: 它总是静静地听我说，好像真的能听懂我的话一样。
sentences.l1: It always listens quietly to what I say, as if it can really understand my words.

sentences.l2: 有时候，我会假装和它说话，它也会“回答”我，虽然只是我自己的声音。
sentences.l1: Sometimes I pretend to talk with it, and it also "answers" me, although it is only my own voice.

sentences.l2: 这只蓝毛衣的泰迪熊，是我房间里最温馨的存在。
sentences.l1: This teddy bear in the blue sweater is the cosiest presence in my room.

sentences.l2: 它虽然不会动，不会说话，但它用它独特的方式陪伴着我。
sentences.l1: Although it cannot move and cannot talk, it keeps me company in its own unique way.

sentences.l2: 有时候，我会把它放在窗台上，让它看着外面的世界。
sentences.l1: Sometimes I put it on the windowsill and let it look at the world outside.

sentences.l2: 它看着小鸟在树上唱歌，看着汽车在路上行驶，看着云彩在天上飘过。
sentences.l1: It watches little birds singing in the trees, watches cars driving on the road, and watches clouds drifting across the sky.

sentences.l2: 我想，它一定也很好奇外面的世界是什么样子的。
sentences.l1: I think it must also be very curious about what the world outside is like.

sentences.l2: 这只熊的毛衣，因为经常被我抱着，有一点点褪色了，但依然是那么好看的蓝色。
sentences.l1: This bear's sweater has faded a tiny bit because I often hug it, but it is still such a nice blue.

sentences.l2: 它的毛也因为长期的触摸，有些地方变得有点扁，但依然柔软。
sentences.l1: Its fur has also become a little flat in some places because of being touched for a long time, but it is still soft.

sentences.l2: 我非常喜欢这只穿着蓝色毛衣的泰迪熊，它是我的宝贝，是我最亲密的伙伴。
sentences.l1: I really like this teddy bear wearing a blue sweater; it is my treasure and my closest companion.

sentences.l2: 它是我童年里不可缺少的一部分，也是我未来回忆里温暖的印记。
sentences.l1: It is an indispensable part of my childhood, and also a warm mark in my future memories.

sentences.l2: 每次看到它，我都会感到一种安心和快乐。
sentences.l1: Every time I see it, I feel a sense of security and happiness.

sentences.l2: 这只熊，就是我的小小的、毛绒绒的、穿着蓝色毛衣的，独一无二的朋友。
sentences.l1: This bear is my little, fluffy, blue-sweater-wearing, one-of-a-kind friend.
